@graph.name: New Magni Gyroplane Sales
@graph.description: Rebel Red's Gyros is a MagniGyro factory-certified dealer offering new Magni M16, M22, M24, and M26 gyroplanes for sale in Texas. Owner Matt Snell is factory certified to sell and support the full Magni gyroplane lineup.

@graph.description: Rebel Red's Gyros offers gyroplane intro flights for $275 and structured flight training programs toward FAA Sport Pilot and Private Pilot certificates. Instructor Matt Snell holds CFI, CFII, and Sport Pilot CFI certificates with specialized gyroplane expertise.

@graph.name: Gyroplane Maintenance and Annual Inspection
@graph.description: Rebel Red's Gyros provides gyroplane maintenance and annual condition inspections for Magni gyroplane owners in Texas. MagniGyro factory-certified expertise ensures your gyroplane is serviced to manufacturer standards.
